question: which are the top selling brands
sql: SELECT sup.PARTYNAME AS Brand, SUM(f.NET_SALE_AMOUNT) AS Sales FROM Fact_Inventory_Sales f JOIN Dim_Supplier sup ON f.Supplier_ID = sup.Supplier_ID GROUP BY sup.PARTYNAME ORDER BY Sales DESC LIMIT 10

question: which are the least selling brands
sql: SELECT sup.PARTYNAME AS Brand, SUM(f.NET_SALE_AMOUNT) AS Sales FROM Fact_Inventory_Sales f JOIN Dim_Supplier sup ON f.Supplier_ID = sup.Supplier_ID GROUP BY sup.PARTYNAME HAVING Sales > 0 ORDER BY Sales ASC LIMIT 10

question: which supplier generated the highest profit
sql: SELECT sup.PARTYNAME AS Supplier, SUM(f.Gross_Profit) AS Gross_Profit FROM Fact_Financial_Metrics f JOIN Dim_Supplier sup ON f.Supplier_ID = sup.Supplier_ID GROUP BY sup.PARTYNAME ORDER BY Gross_Profit DESC LIMIT 1

question: which are the top selling products
sql: SELECT p.ICODE, SUM(f.NET_SALE_AMOUNT) AS Sales FROM Fact_Inventory_Sales f JOIN Dim_Product p ON f.Product_ID = p.Product_ID GROUP BY p.ICODE ORDER BY Sales DESC LIMIT 10

question: which are the least selling products
sql: SELECT p.ICODE, SUM(f.NET_SALE_AMOUNT) AS Sales FROM Fact_Inventory_Sales f JOIN Dim_Product p ON f.Product_ID = p.Product_ID GROUP BY p.ICODE HAVING Sales > 0 ORDER BY Sales ASC LIMIT 10
